params.description: a floating plague god, curtain of long black hair over a pale grey mask face with glowing amber eyes and gaping black mouth, tall tattered dark grey-green rotting robe whose hem fades into smoke, long sleeves ending in bone claws, green weeping sores on cloth, dark muted palette, Korean Silla folklore
